work_items.title: Restore the required runner path
acceptance: Read both queued job labels, runner-group access, online/idle state and queue cause.
Obtain non-empty terminal-success execution for the final head and prospective merge; no duplicate queued rerun and no changed required checks.

work_items.title: Apply and read back protected admission
acceptance: Read the effective policy including inherited rules and every bypass actor.
Require existing complete checks, two eligible approvals, CODEOWNERS/latest-push, stale-review handling, conversation resolution and force/delete rejection.
Use independently approved disposable positive/negative probes; never risk deleting main.

work_items.title: Verify one immutable candidate
acceptance: Bind source, tree, base, actual merge, toolchain, lock, migrations, workflow attempts and artifact digests.
Resolve substantive findings and obtain fresh non-author code and independent-security reviews; no source-authored approval.

work_items.title: Converge Matrix documentation
acceptance: Relay, Adapter, Consumer, canonical CLI and migrations agree on v3/0006.
Adapter repaired-to-sent is not presented as proof of a Matrix message receipt.

work_items.title: Converge research state semantics
acceptance: Keep stored reproducing; present author reproduction_readiness and assign independent reproduction to Review Raid.
Preserve author/reviewer independence, old stored reads and explicit role/command mappings.

work_items.title: Complete all module detailed designs
acceptance: All actual Cargo members and discovered targets map to contracts and accountable owner roles.
For every applicable dimension, reviewed field-level design, negative examples and source/test links exist; generic prose and file presence are insufficient.
An engineer outside the original implementation can modify, test and recover the module without undocumented rules.

work_items.title: Qualify the exact-money end-to-end chain
acceptance: Ingress/reserve/execution/consume-or-refund/Audit share stable immutable operation identities.
Exercise concurrent terminal decisions, network loss before/after side effect, crash and cross-tenant replay; no unexplained balance or history delta.

work_items.title: Qualify actual Matrix v3 recovery
acceptance: Run actual canonical CLI as the runtime role after complete migrations, including honest replay with fresh envelopes.
Deny v1/v2 and direct DML; reject each task/delivery/payload/principal mutation; real response loss creates no second business action.

work_items.title: Qualify the independent research workflow
acceptance: Three author roles and distinct independent evaluator/reviewers/reproducer complete the intended flow.
Leases, key epochs, contribution uniqueness, appeals and finality holds survive restart and competing instances.

work_items.title: Unify multi-schema migration acceptance
acceptance: Inventory global, Hepta, BFF, Matrix transport/operator and TRNM bootstrap streams from actual source.
Fresh apply, existing-row upgrade, incompatible historical rows, mixed old/new instances and restart are exercised.
Record lock duration, expand/contract boundaries and forward repair; no destructive rollback or invented historical money.

work_items.title: Unify identities and configuration
acceptance: Specify issuer/principal, tenant, credential scope, TTL, rotation/revocation and cache propagation for every boundary.
Test conflicting profiles, missing durability, unsafe endpoints and timeout/lease inequalities before startup.

work_items.title: Freeze numerical performance and recovery targets
acceptance: Approve workload, topology, dataset, concurrency, throughput, p95/p99 latency, queue age, RTO/RPO and endurance targets before execution.
Separate business requirement, measured qualification and production observation; blank targets or post-hoc targets cannot pass.

work_items.title: Execute representative load and disaster recovery
acceptance: Retain load generation, monitoring, fault schedule and restore/PITR artifacts with exact candidate and topology binding.
Meet frozen thresholds and reconcile all committed identities, balances and histories; synthetic fixtures do not replace representative evidence.

work_items.title: Define and qualify Alpha-to-public-Beta promotion
acceptance: Keep loopback/SSH Alpha separate from public HTTPS, real OIDC/JWKS, account recovery, abuse controls and support.
Public activation requires actual end-to-end identity, browser, credential-custody and privacy evidence.

work_items.title: Complete provenance and bounded advisory disposition
acceptance: Record independent provenance for trnm-economy-protocol without borrowing the four-crate Chain manifest.
Execute current feature/release reachability and expiry policy; link existing risk issue #35 and obtain independent disposition, not a new automatic waiver.

work_items.title: Accept the cross-repository tuple
acceptance: World fixture, Game/Nakama, Chain, CEX and contract bytes use immutable accepted identities.
Independent owners accept compatibility, authority transfer and no-dual-writer evidence; a checked-out sibling is not authority.

work_items.title: Replace runtime monkey-patching with explicit composition
acceptance: Propose a typed transport/validation/SQL boundary with direct v3 function construction.
Keep every historical and hostile test; no permission, migration or outcome-semantic widening; requalify after refactor.

work_items.title: Reduce internal coupling and review size
acceptance: Separate bounded domains and fixtures before creating additional services.
Use small reviewable follow-up PRs and one final evidence freeze; no history rewrite or large unrelated patch.

work_items.title: Maintain living technical specifications
acceptance: Generate supported API/configuration inventories from source and validate linked schema/examples.
Version current contracts, archive superseded instructions and distinguish structural lint from reviewed completeness.

work_items.title: Decide final production go/no-go
acceptance: Verify all applicable V12-X1 through V12-X8 records, issuer independence, custody, retention and revocation.
The final accountable human decision binds the actual qualified artifact; repository code and this plan never grant production authority.

acceptance_cases.expected: Canonical money and receipt serialization preserves exact bytes.
Reject overflow, noncanonical amounts and unknown authoritative versions.
Old-reader/new-writer fixtures fail safely rather than infer missing authority.
Every public error code has a stable serialization and service mapping.
Unknown remote outcome cannot map to an automatic retryable failure.
Secrets and cross-tenant existence information are absent from serialized errors.
Initialization behavior is deterministic under repeated initialization.
Sensitive request, credential and research fixtures are absent from captured logs.
Field names, cardinality budgets, filter behavior and loss/backpressure policy are documented.
Every supported profile alias and precedence combination is enumerated.
Conflicting, empty, unknown or non-Unicode explicit profiles fail before runtime startup.
Credential, timeout and lease boundaries are tested across every consuming service.
Each signed frame has an explicit field order, encoding and domain separator.
Tampering every authority field, key, version, expiry and nonce is rejected.
Golden vectors stay immutable and run across all supported consumers.
Issue, replay, revoke, rotate and expiry operations have field-level contracts and errors.
A wrong tenant, wrong administrative principal or reused identity with changed bytes is rejected.
Missing durable storage fails before listening; revoke propagation and cache invalidation are measured.
Opening, reserve, consume and refund have complete transition and invariant tables.
Concurrent consume/refund, content collision, insufficient funds and cross-tenant receipt lookup are rejected safely.
Response-loss recovery returns the same exact operation and restored projections reconcile to append-only entries.
Issuer, signature, audience, time, nonce and canonical intent are independently validated.
Concurrent budget use and repeated entitlements cannot create a second financial effect.
Response-loss recovery preserves original intent bytes and verified Ledger receipt identity.
Invocation ingress explicitly defines authentication, exact amount fields and normalization.
Dual legacy/exact intent, stale claims, cross-tenant requests and changed replay bytes are rejected.
Reserve intent commits before I/O and unknown outcomes recover without a new operation identity.
External-Agent work admission, lifecycle and exact settlement states are mapped independently.
Retired process routes remain absent and default builds perform no model or provider execution.
Crash, stale owner, terminal race, unknown Ledger outcome and authenticated repair preserve immutable identity.
Hash input bytes, per-scope sequence, event schema and acknowledgement are explicit.
Wrong writer, cross-scope append, changed replay and mutation of historical events are rejected.
ACK loss, baseline restart, backlog pressure and archive restore retain verifiable chain continuity.
Registry source, digest, versions and reload or restart semantics are explicit.
Malformed, oversized, duplicate or local-model declarations fail closed.
Readiness distinguishes validated declarations from actual external-Agent availability.
Session, identity, task and projection routes have distinct ownership and field contracts.
Recovery rejects wrong delivery, payload, event, room, subject and missing task/invocation equality.
A persisted result lookup performs no task replay and cannot establish World, Ledger or research authority.
Stored reproducing maps to author reproduction_readiness; independent reproduction belongs to Review Raid.
Author/reviewer/reproducer independence, Agent key epochs and stale lease or version violations are rejected.
Restart, contribution uniqueness, appeal/rework and finality transitions retain immutable research lineage.
Session, CSRF, invitation, Agent pairing and downstream assertion contracts are documented independently.
The seven-human Alpha topology and distinct review seats remain enforceable without account substitution.
Public OIDC and HTTPS activation require real IdP, JWKS, callback and custody evidence rather than an Alpha switch.
Operator migrations 0001 through 0006 and the v3-only runtime grant are verified on PostgreSQL.
The real least-privilege CLI rejects wrong task, invocation, delivery, payload, event, room and subject.
Fresh observation timestamps replay the same stable result without another terminal transition or business request.
Current recovery documentation names v3 and operator migration 0006.
Adapter unknown outcomes hold without blind task replay; changed transport scope or receipt identity is rejected.
Recovered adapter completion and actual Matrix send receipt are reported as different states.
Opaque cursor, immutable account/filter scope, bootstrap and history-gap rules are explicit.
Stale lease, token cycles, duplicate JSON keys, filter drift and poison events cannot silently advance the cursor.
Real homeserver interruption and bounded long-gap recovery preserve event deduplication and quarantine evidence.
Independent upstream origin, version, licence and any downstream patch are recorded and verified.
Shape validation cannot substitute for signature, issuer trust, nonce or cumulative budget enforcement.
Each consuming service runs canonical entitlement and exact-value compatibility fixtures.
Each receipt and proof version has bounded canonical encoding and cross-language vectors.
Untrusted receipt-supplied validator sets and malformed hashes cannot become trusted defaults.
Consumer trust-anchor rotation and retention preserve accepted receipt verification context.
Linux library and Unix CLI targets are qualified separately from the Windows library exception.
Wrong trust anchors, malformed evidence, file substitution and signing/verification confusion are rejected.
Upstream origin and the exact permitted test-only patch are independently checked before accepted verification.
Canonical transaction bytes, limits, version tags and signed-command binding have fixed vectors.
Alternative encodings, altered replay, unknown schema and mismatched signed payloads fail closed.
All consumers preserve original nonce and request identity through response loss and upgrades.
Deterministic CBOR tags, byte order and authority-role mapping have cross-language vectors.
Wrong role, DID/key, command replay bytes or snapshot graph cannot create accepted state.
Snapshot upgrade and restore preserve canonical commitments and all command replay history.
